blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automated segmentation is routinely used as the first step in quantitative image-based clinical workflows, where predicted masks are subsequently reviewed and corrected by human operators. Automated correction of the residual structural errors is currently addressed one anatomy at a time, so the number of trained correctors scales with the number of segmentation targets. We present GRACE, a retrieval-augmented refiner that edits an input mask under context drawn from a shared knowledge base of verified prior cases. The refiner is trained once on a multi-organ corpus spanning compact organs, cavities, branching vessels, and tumour lesions. In the held-out dataset-transfer evaluation, three held-out datasets query a fixed knowledge base built from training data only. A separate leave-one-anatomy-out experiment tests parameter-free index extension: verified cases of an unseen solid organ enter the knowledge base, and the refiner stays frozen. A light shape-aware projection head on a frozen multimodal encoder maps embedding similarity to the shape agreement of the masks, so the knowledge base returns cases that the refiner can use as a shape prior. We evaluate GRACE on 18 public datasets spanning CT, MRI and ultrasound, using nine refinement configurations and seven upstream segmentors that span weak, mid, and strong operating regimes. We report each change with the DSC of its input mask. On the weak tier, the input DSC is 0.386 and GRACE adds up to +0.35 DSC. On a strong segmentor, the input DSC is 0.932 and the mean change is small. Transfer to an imaging modality that is absent from training and from the index is partial and depends on the anatomy, and remains an open research direction. Our results suggest retrieval-conditioned refinement is a practical alternative to anatomy-specific correction models. Code: https://github.com/robustml-eurecom/grace
blocks.zh: 自动化分解通常被作为以图像为基础的定量临床工作流程的第一步,其中预测的口罩随后由人类操作者审查并纠正. 剩余结构误差的自动校正目前一次处理一个解剖学问题,因此训练有素的校正器量与分化目标数量相仿. 我们介绍GRACE,这是一个检索增强的精炼器,在从已核实的先前案例共享知识库中提取的上下文下编辑一个输入口罩。 精炼者接受过一次关于多器官的训练,这些器官包括紧凑器官、腔道、分枝器和肿瘤损伤。 在被搁置的数据集传输评价中,三个被搁置的数据集查询了仅从培训数据中建立的固定知识库。 单独放行一解剖实验测试参数无索引扩展:已核实的未见固体器官病例进入知识库,精炼者会被冻结. 在被冻结的多式编码器地图上以浅色的形状感知投影头嵌入了与口罩的形状协议相类似之处,因此知识库会返回炼油器可以用作形状的前作的大小写. 我们利用9个精密配置和7个上游分路器,对覆盖CT、核磁共振和超声波的18个公共数据集进行评估,它们跨越薄弱、中和强大的操作系统。 我们用DSC的输入口罩报告每个变化. 在弱层,输入DSC为0.386,GRACE加起来为+0.35 DSC. 在强分管上,输入DSC为0.932,平均变化为小分管. 向没有参加培训和指数的成像模式转移是部分的,取决于解剖学,仍然是开放的研究方向。 我们的结果显示,有检索条件的完善是解剖学特定校正模型的实用替代. 代码:https://github.com/robustml-eurecom/grace (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Medical image segmentation has advanced rapidly with deep learning ( Isensee et al., 2021 ; Hatamizadeh et al., 2022 ; Ma et al., 2024 ) , becoming the de facto approach for extracting anatomical structures in clinical workflows. Although widely adopted, state-of-the-art models remain prone to structural errors and artifacts that require costly manual correction before clinical use ( Azad et al., 2023 ; Galati et al., 2022 ) . These artifacts typically manifest as over-segmentation, under-segmentation, boundary imprecision, or topological violations. Challenging cases involve ambiguous boundaries, small structures, or out-of-distribution pathologies that deviate from the expected normative anatomy ( Galati et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 医学影像分解随着深入学习而迅速推进(Isensee等人,2021年;Hatamizadeh等人,2022年;Ma等人,2024年),成为临床工作流程中提取解剖结构的实际方法. 虽然广泛采用,但最先进的模型仍然容易发生结构错误和文物,在临床使用前需要花费昂贵的人工校正(Azad等人,2023年;Galati等人,2022年). 这些文物一般表现为过分分化,分化不足,边界不精确,或地形侵犯. 挑战性案例涉及模糊的界限,小的结构,或偏离预期规范解剖的分布外病变(Galati等人,2022年)。

blocks.en: Despite these advances in segmentation accuracy, automated correction of segmentation errors remains an open problem . Unlike segmentation, which predicts pixel-wise labels from image intensities, correction requires reasoning about anatomical plausibility and restoring coherent structures from imperfect predictions. Despite growing interest in automated segmentation quality control and refinement ( Valindria et al., 2017 ; Robinson et al., 2018 ; Audelan and Delingette, 2019 ; Liu et al., 2019 ; Robinson et al., 2019 ; Larrazabal et al., 2020 ; Painchaud et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Fournel et al., 2021 ; Lin et al., 2023 ; Qiu et al., 2023 ; Marcianò et al., 2026 ) , the field currently lacks generalisable , fully-automated solutions.
blocks.zh: 尽管在分解准确性方面取得了这些进步,但分解错误的自动纠正仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。 与从图像强度中预测像素偏导标签的分解不同,校正需要对解剖学的可信度进行推理,并从不完善的预测中恢复连贯的结构. 尽管对自动分区质量控制和完善的兴趣越来越大(Valindria等人,2017年;Robinson等人,2018年;Audelan and Delingette,2019年;Liu等人,2019年;Robinson等人,2019年;Larrazabal等人,2020年;Painchaud等人,2020年;Wang等人,2020年;Fournel等人,2021年;Lin等人,2023年;Quu等人,2023年;Marcianò等人,2026年),但该领域目前缺乏通用,完全自动化的解决方案.

blocks.en: Existing approaches largely fall into two restrictive paradigms. On the one hand, single-anatomy specialists ( Larrazabal et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Painchaud et al., 2020 ) learn to encode anatomical shape priors, which are then used to validate and improve anatomically implausible segmentations. However, while effective, these approaches require training a dedicated model from scratch for each new organ or imaging modality. Another set of techniques interprets refinement as a signal restoration problem, where given a corrupted mask, the goal is to recover the anatomically plausible structure ( Yuan et al., 2020 ; Terris et al., 2026 ) . While such models demonstrate strong capabilities in generic signal restoration, they do not explicitly incorporate structured anatomical priors, which are critical for correcting geometric segmentation errors.
blocks.zh: 现有办法基本上属于两个限制性模式。 一方面,单体解剖专家(Larrazabal等人,2020年;Wang等人,2020年;Painchaud等人,2020年)学会编码解剖形状前科,然后用于验证和改进解剖不合理分解. 然而,这些方法虽然有效,但需要从零开始为每个新器官或成像模式培训专用模型。 另一组技术将精炼解释为信号恢复问题,给与腐烂的面具,目标是恢复解剖上可信的结构(袁等人,2020年;泰里斯等人,2026年)。 虽然这些模型在通用信号恢复方面显示出强大的能力,但它们并没有明确纳入结构化解剖前科,这对于纠正几何分解错误至关重要.

blocks.en:
We argue that medical segmentation refinement can be naturally formulated as a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) problem ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) . Given a corrupted segmentation, a model retrieves anatomically similar cases from a knowledge base and conditions the refinement process on this retrieved context. In this way, anatomy-specific information is provided at inference time rather than being encoded into the model parameters, enabling a single refiner to operate across organs and imaging modalities represented in the knowledge base. Although retrieval has become a powerful paradigm for knowledge-intensive learning, its potential for anatomy-agnostic segmentation refinement remains largely unexplored.
To this end, we present GRACE (Generalist Retrieval-Augmented Correction for Segmentation Errors) as a retrieval-conditioned segmentation-refinement framework (Fig. 1 ) that separates anatomy-aware retrieval from the refiner representation. The framework itself does not commit to a particular refinement representation: pixel-space and latent-space refiners are treated as interchangeable instantiations of a common retrieval interface. Our contributions are, thus, summarised as follows:
blocks.zh:
我们主张,医学分解的完善可以自然地被表述为"检索-增强代(RAG)问题"(Lewis等人,2020年). 由于存在腐烂的分裂,一个模型从知识库中检索解剖学上相似的病例,并为这个被检索的上下文的完善过程创造条件. 这样,在推论时提供解剖学特定信息,而不是编码成模型参数,使单一的精炼器能够跨器官运行和在知识库中代表的成像模式. 虽然检索已成为知识密集型学习的有力范例,但其解剖学-不可知分解的精细化潜力基本上仍未探索.

blocks.en: • A retrieval-augmented framework for segmentation refinement whose common interface supports both pixel-space and latent-space refiners. The retrieval step supplies anatomy-specific information at inference time, allowing a single anatomy-agnostic refiner to generalise across the organs and imaging modalities represented in the knowledge base . The framework can use a fixed knowledge base or incorporate verified support cases without retraining the refiner. • Exemplar-conditioned refinement. The retrieved mask enters the refiner as a spatial channel and gives the shape prior for the correction. When we set this channel to zero, the refiner loses 40 % 40\% of its gain at the most severe preset (Sec. 4.5 ). A shape-aware retrieval projector on a frozen multimodal encoder selects the same-class case. Its contribution is smaller, and we report it as a component ablation (Table 5 ). • Three complementary instantiations of the proposed framework spanning deterministic pixel-space refinement, deterministic latent refinement, and latent flow matching. We compare all three across the upstream operating regimes and on the trade-off between accuracy and runtime. • Extensive validation across 18 public datasets, multiple imaging modalities, seven upstream segmentors, and nine refinement configurations, including three held-out datasets for held-out dataset transfer and a leave-one-modality-out study. We also analyse retrieval, knowledge-base scaling, robustness to a wrong class query, case-level failure rates and statistical significance , and release the code, pretrained models, and knowledge base.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Segmentation refinement is a distinct problem from segmentation itself and has been approached along three main lines. The first is classical, hand-designed post-processing that enforces geometric or topological constraints on the raw prediction: morphological operations and connected-component filtering to remove small false-positive blobs or retain the largest anatomically plausible regions ( Isensee et al., 2021 ; Dulau et al., 2023 ) and topological penalties ensuring continuous boundaries ( Hu et al., 2019 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . These methods are fast and interpretable but cannot recover structure that was never in the raw prediction, and their handcrafted rules do not transfer across anatomies. The second line replaces handcrafted rules with
learned anatomical priors, typically encoded through autoencoders, variational autoencoders, or more recently latent diffusion models ( Oktay et al., 2018 ; Larrazabal et al., 2020 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Painchaud et al., 2020 ; Galati and Zuluaga, 2021 ; Marcianò et al., 2026 ) . These methods learn a manifold of anatomically plausible segmentations that guides refinement. However, as the manifold is typically learned for a single anatomy, these methods require retraining for each new organ or imaging modality.
Finally, the third line does not consider a dedicated corrector, approaching the problem via test-time adaptation (TTA) ( Karani et al., 2021 ) . Instead, the upstream segmentor is briefly refitted on each test volume to close a domain gap. TTA improves segmentation performance without producing a corrected mask directly. Therefore, it is complementary to a refiner rather than a substitute for it. GRACE sits in the refiner slot, replaces the per-anatomy autoencoder with a single retrieval-conditioned refiner trained once on multi-organ data, and preserves the conservative behaviour of morphological post-processing on inputs that do not need correction.
blocks.zh:
分化的完善与分化本身是一个截然不同的问题,是按三个主要方面处理的。 第一种是古典式的手工设计后处理,对原始预测实施几何或地形限制:形态操作和连接组件过滤,以去除小的假阳性斑块或保留最大的解剖上可信的区域(Isensee等人,2021年;Dulau等人,2023年)和确保连续边界的地形惩罚(Hu等人,2019年;Li等人,2025年)。 这些方法速度快,可解释,但无法恢复原始预测中从未有过的结构,其手工制作的规则不会跨越解剖. 第二行将手动规则替换为
学习解剖学前科,通常通过自动编码器、变异自动编码器或最近的潜在扩散模型编码(Oktay等人,2018年;Larrazabal等人,2020年;Wang等人,2020年;Painchaud等人,2020年;Galati和Zuluaga,2021年;Marcianò等人,2026年)。 这些方法学习了多种解剖学上可行的分解,指导着完善。 然而,由于对单一解剖学通常会学习多种方法,这些方法要求每个新器官或成像模式进行再培训。
最后,第三行不考虑专门的校正器,通过测试时间适应(TTA)来接近问题(Karani等人,2021年). 相反,上游部分在每一个测试量上被短暂重置,以关闭一个域间隙. TTA改进分解性能,而不直接产生一个经过纠正的面具. 因此,它是炼油厂的补充而不是替代。 GRACE坐落在炼油槽中,用一次接受过多器官数据培训的单一检索条件的炼油器取代了每安非他明的自动编码器,并保留了形态处理后对不需要修正的投入的保守行为.

blocks.en: Recent foundation and generalist models have broadened anatomical coverage through diverse paradigms, including prompt-based segmentation ( Ma et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Wong et al., 2024 ) , large-scale supervised learning ( Wasserthal et al., 2023 ) , few-shot segmentation ( Butoi et al., 2023 ) , and text-conditioned segmentation ( Rokuss et al., 2026 ) . While these methods demonstrate broad generalisation across anatomies and modalities, they are designed for forward segmentation prediction rather than post-hoc correction and refinement. RAM ( Terris et al., 2026 ) extends the foundation-model paradigm to generic inverse imaging problems without task-specific training, but operates in pixel space and does not explicitly exploit anatomical context for segmentation correction.
blocks.zh: 最近的基础和通论模式通过多种范式扩大了解剖范围,包括迅速分解(Ma等人,2024年;Wang等人,2025年b); Ma等人,2025年;Wong等人,2024年),大规模监督学习(Wasserthal等人,2023年),几发分片(Butoi等人,2023年),以及文本条件分片(Rokuss等人,2026年). 虽然这些方法在解剖学和模式上表现出了广泛的概括性,但它们的设计是为了前向分解预测,而不是事后的校正和完善. RAM(Terris et al., 2026)将基础模型范式扩展至通用反向成像问题而不进行任务特定训练,但在像素空间中运行,并且没有明确利用解剖背景来进行分解校正.

blocks.en: Retrieval-augmented learning ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) has recently been explored in medical AI for report generation ( Xia et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2024 ; Hsu et al., 2025 ) and few-shot segmentation from retrieved annotated examples ( Ahmed et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . In these settings, retrieval provides external knowledge to improve prediction or support inference. In contrast, retrieval for direct segmentation refinement has received little attention. GRACE retrieves anatomically similar cases to provide inference-time context for correcting an existing segmentation.
blocks.zh: 最近,医学AI为编写报告(霞等人,2025年;Xiong等人,2024年;Hsu等人,2025年)和从检索到的附加说明的例子中少许镜头分解(Ahmed等人,2026年;Zhao等人,2025年)。 在这些环境下,检索提供外部知识,以改善预测或支持推论. 相比之下,用于直接分化改进的检索却很少受到重视。 GRACE检索解剖学上相似的病例,以提供推断时间背景来纠正现有的分解.

blocks.en:
Compact latent representations have become a standard paradigm for modelling anatomically plausible structures in medical imaging.
Early formulations use variational autoencoders (VAEs) as shape priors, learning latent manifolds of plausible organ shapes for segmentation refinement and shape reconstruction ( Painchaud et al., 2020 ; Larrazabal et al., 2020 ; Beetz et al., 2022 ) .
Vector-Quantised VAEs ( Razavi et al., 2019 ) and multi-scale volumetric encoders ( Pinaya et al., 2022 ; Fernandez et al., 2024 ) extended this framework to high-resolution 3D image and mask generation.
Latent diffusion models ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) and, more recently, rectified flow models ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) enable efficient generative sampling directly in these compact latent spaces, making full-volume 3D synthesis computationally tractable ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Tang et al., 2025 ) . Conditioning strategies have subsequently evolved from partial-noise editing, such as SDEdit ( Meng et al., 2022 ) , to retrieval-guided generation, where retrieved exemplars provide structural guidance during sampling ( Molino et al., 2026 ) . GRACE builds on this latter paradigm by performing class-filtered, shape-aware retrieval to guide segmentation refinement, and supports deterministic pixel-space, deterministic latent-space, and latent flow-based refiners within a unified framework.

blocks.en: These two factors, the refinement paradigm (deterministic or generative) and the representation (pixel or latent space), can be combined to instantiate different refinement architectures within the same retrieval framework. In our work, they give rise to three variants: a deterministic pixel-space network (GRACE-U), a deterministic latent autoencoder (GRACE-M), and a latent flow-matching model (GRACE-M-D). GRACE-U is a 3D U-Net with three input channels: the corrupted mask, the image and the retrieved exemplar. It gives a foreground logit for each voxel in one forward pass. GRACE-M encodes the corrupted mask and the exemplar into a 4 × 24 3 4{\times}24^{3} latent with a frozen encoder. A small module fuses the two latents, and a mask-tuned decoder gives the refined mask. GRACE-M-D uses the same latent interface but integrates a learned velocity field with an ODE solver. Thus, several runs on one input give a set of plausible refinements. All three variants use the same retrieval context. Appendix A gives the full architectures.
blocks.zh: 这两个因素,即完善范式(决定式或基因式)和表现式(像素或潜在空间),可以结合到同一检索框架内的即时化不同的完善架构. 在我们的工作中,它们产生了三个变体:决定像素-空间网络(GRACE-U),决定性潜在自动编码器(GRACE-M),以及潜在的流量匹配模型(GRACE-M-D)。 GRACE-U是一个3D U-Net,有三个输入通道:腐烂的面具,图像和被检索的示例. 它给出了一个前传中每个狐狸的前传记录. GRACE-M将腐烂的面具和模具编码成 4×24 3}4}24×3}用冷冻的编码器潜伏 一个小模块将两个潜伏物引信,一个面具调制的解码器会给精制的面具. GRACE-M-D使用相同的潜伏界面,但将一个学习到的速度场与ODE解析器融合. 因此,对一项投入进行的几次审查提供了一套合理的改进。 所有三种变体都使用相同的检索上下文. 附 录 A给出了完整的建筑.

blocks.en: 3.5 Two-phase training and corruption schedule
blocks.zh: 3.5 两级培训和反腐败时间表

blocks.en: Training ℛ θ \mathcal{R}_{\theta} directly on corrupted masks produced by one specific upstream segmentor risks injection bias: the refiner overfits to the failure modes of that segmentor. To prevent this bias, we train the refiner on synthetic corruptions of the ground-truth masks. A corruption combines morphological erosion and dilation, elastic boundary deformation, boundary noise, false-positive blobs and axis-aligned slice dropout ( Jebril et al., 2025 ) . Three severity presets ( default , mid , strong ) define the synthetic-corruption experiments; a fourth training preset ( mixed ) samples uniformly across the three severities. Two more presets, very_strong and extreme , go beyond the range of the training severities. We use them only for evaluation, in the analyses of Sec. 4.5 . Representative synthetic corruptions are shown in Fig. 5 .
blocks.zh: R \ mathcal{R}_{\Theta}直接在某个特定的上游分机产生的腐烂口罩上进行训练,有可能导致注射偏差:精炼器过度适用于该分机的故障模式。 为防止这种偏见,我们培训精炼师,使其了解地真相面具的合成腐败。 腐败结合了形态侵蚀和扩张、弹性边界变形、边界噪声、假阳性斑点和轴向切片脱落(Jebril等人,2025年)。 三个严重性预设(默认,中,强)定义了合成腐败实验;第四个训练预设(混合)样本在三个断层之间统一. 另外两个预设,非常... 强烈和极端, 超越训练范围 断裂。 我们只用它们来评估, 在分析4.5. 图5显示了代表性的合成腐败。

blocks.en: Training has two phases. Phase 1 trains the refiner, and Phase 2 fits the retrieval projector ϕ ψ \phi_{\psi} of Sec. 3.3 . In Phase 1, we train the refiner from random initialisation for 100 epochs at 96 3 96^{3} resolution. We use AdamW with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a cosine schedule, batch size 8, gradient clipping at 1.0 and mixed precision. The loss combines Dice and cross-entropy against the clean ground truth. The mixed preset corrupts each input with probability 0.95 0.95 , so a small fraction of clean inputs keeps the identity behaviour. The exemplar is set to zero with probability 0.10 0.10 . Thus, the refiner stays usable when retrieval gives no result, and it cannot use the exemplar as a shortcut. The corruption changes for each sample and each epoch. In Phase 2, we fit ϕ ψ \phi_{\psi} for 20 epochs on pairs of knowledge-base cases (Eq. 2 ). Phase 2 does not change the refiner.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验装置

blocks.en: The training corpus covers 15 public datasets across CT, MRI, and US and contains 3,866 volumes over 38 anatomical structures across the abdomen, thorax, pelvis, brain, and cardiac chambers (Table 12 in Appendix F ). Multi-class labels are converted to per-organ binary instances; for multi-channel Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) ( Antonelli et al., 2022 ) tasks the T2-weighted modality is used. Three datasets are excluded from both training and indexing and are used for held-out dataset-transfer evaluation: ProstateX ( Armato III et al., 2018 ) (346 subjects, multiparametric prostate MRI), CHAOS ( Kavur et al., 2021 ) (40 CT subjects, liver / kidneys / spleen; CHAOS also has MRI scans of these organs, which Sec. 4.4 uses), and LUMIERE ( Suter et al., 2022 ) (91 GBM patients across 2–20 longitudinal visits each, 599 timepoints).
blocks.zh: 培训内容涵盖整个CT、核磁共振和美国的15个公共数据集,包含3,866卷,涉及整个腹部、胸腔、盆腔、大脑和心脏室的38个解剖结构(附录F表12)。 多类标签被转换成每个器官的二进制实例;对于多通道的医学分块德甲斯隆(MSD)(Antonelli等人,2022年)任务使用T2加权模式. 3个数据集被排除在培训和索引之外,用于搁置数据集转移评价:前列腺X(Armato III等人,2018年) (346个科目,多参数前列腺核磁共振),CHAOS(Kavur等人,2021年) (40个CT科目,肝/肾/脾;CHAOS还对这些器官进行了MRI扫描,Sec 4.4使用),以及LUMIERE(Suter等人,2022年) (91个GBM患者,每次纵向访问2-20次,时间点599次)。

blocks.en: We report Dice coefficient (DSC, ↑ \uparrow ), 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95, ↓ \downarrow ), and signed deltas over the raw upstream prediction. Unless a caption states otherwise, “ ± \pm ” denotes the sample standard deviation across cases. Figure 3 instead shows variability across anatomy–dataset pairs, and Table 6 reports runtime variability across repeated runs. HD95 is reported in millimetres for real-segmentor evaluations and in voxels for synthetic-corruption analyses.
blocks.zh: 我们报告Dice系数(DSC, \ oparrow ), 95百分位的Husdorff距离(HD95, \\ downarrow ), 在原始的上游预测上签下三角洲。 除非标题另有说明,否则“±\\pm ”表示不同案例的样本标准差。 相反,图3显示的是解剖学-数据集对的变异性,表6报告的是重复运行的运行时间变异性。 HD95的报告以毫米表示,用于实分层评价,以Voxel表示,用于合成腐败分析。

blocks.en: Seven segmentors span three operating regimes. Weak : a MONAI ( Cardoso et al., 2022 ) 3D U-Net trained for 30 epochs on 10% of each organ split (U-Net@30). Mid : MedSAM2 ( Ma et al., 2025 ) and ScribblePrompt ( Wong et al., 2024 ) used with an oracle bounding box derived from the ground truth on the highest-coverage axial slice, and SwinUNETR-BTCV ( Hatamizadeh et al., 2022 ) . ScribblePrompt and SwinUNETR-BTCV are used for the held-out dataset evaluation (Sec. 4.3 ). Strong : TotalSegmentator ( Wasserthal et al., 2023 ) in fast mode on CT organs; a MONAI 3D U-Net trained for 150 epochs on the full split (U-Net@150); a MONAI SegResNet trained for 150 epochs on the full split (SegResNet). This split characterises GRACE when the input carries little usable signal as well as when it is close to correct.
blocks.zh: 7个分部跨越三个操作系统。 弱: MONAI(Cardoso等人,2022年) U-Net为30个时代培训了10%的器官分裂(U-Net@30)。 中段:MedSAM2(Ma等人,2025年)和ScribblePrompt(Wong等人,2024年)在最高覆盖轴切片上使用由地面真相推导出的标定框,以及SwinUNETR-BTCV(Hatamizadeh等人,2022年). ScriblePrompt和SwinUNETR-BTCV用于搁置数据集评价(第4.3条)。 强:总分 (Wasserthal等人,2023年),CT器官的快速模式;MONAI 3D U-Net为150个纪元接受了关于完全分裂的培训(U-Net@150);MONAI SegResNet为150个纪元进行了关于完全分裂的培训(SegResNet)。 这种分裂的特性在输入没有多少可用信号时以及输入接近正确时,即为GRACE.

blocks.en: We split each dataset case-wise into disjoint training and test parts. (i) For Table 1 and the synthetic analyses, one refiner trains on the training split, and we evaluate it on the test split. It sees other cases of the same datasets, but never the evaluated cases. (ii) For Table 2 , we apply the same refiner to three datasets that are absent from training and from the index. (iii) For Table 3 (Block A), we retrain the refiner from scratch for each held-out anatomy. That anatomy is absent from training and from the index. At test time, only support cases enter the index, and they are disjoint from the queries. (iv) Block B of Table 3 applies the same protocol to a full modality. We rebuild the index for each protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们把每个数据集按个案分解成不结合的培训和测试部分。 (一)表1和合成分析,一个精炼机列车在训练分离,我们在试验分离上评价. 它看到其他相同的数据集,但从未看到评估过的案件。 (二) 对于表2,我们对三个没有参加培训和指数的数据集采用同样的精炼器。 (三) 对于表3(Block A),我们对精炼器进行从头到尾的再培训,用于每个被搁置的解剖学。 解剖学在培训和指数上都不存在。 在测试时,只支持案例输入索引,它们与查询脱节. (四) 表3的B项对完全方式适用同样的协议。 我们重建每个协议的索引。

blocks.en: Nine refiner variants are compared: (i) no refinement (raw upstream); (ii) morphological (binary closing then binary opening with a 3 × 3 × 3 3{\times}3{\times}3 structuring element); (iii) test-time augmentation (TTAug) with eight views and mean aggregation; (iv) PostDAE ( Larrazabal et al., 2020 ) ; (v) RAM ( Terris et al., 2026 ) ; (vi) a MONAI 3D U-Net refiner without retrieval ( U-Net w/o RAG ) that takes ( Y ∗ , X ) (Y^{*},X) as input; (vii) the same U-Net with the retrieved exemplar as a third input channel (GRACE-U); (viii) a latent autoencoder refiner that fuses the exemplar in the latent bottleneck before decoding (GRACE-M); (ix) the same latent refiner with flow-matching inference (GRACE-M-D), averaged over three ODE seeds . No baseline receives the target class as input. PostDAE uses the class implicitly, through one model for each anatomy. This is the strongest form of class conditioning. The morphological, TTAug and RAM baselines cannot use a label. U-Net w/o RAG receives only ( Y ∗ , X ) (Y^{*},X) . GRACE uses the class to select the retrieval candidates. To separate the effect of the class from the effect of the exemplar, we also train U-Net w/o RAG with the class label. A one-hot embedding and FiLM inject the label, and no exemplar is given. The label improves only the weak inputs ( + 0.081 +0.081 vs. + 0.049 +0.049 on U-Net@30) and does not change the mid and strong inputs ( − 0.002 -0.002 on MedSAM2, − 0.004 -0.004 on TotalSegmentator). GRACE-U still gives a larger gain on weak inputs. Thus, the class label explains little of the advantage of GRACE. This baseline is different from the zeroed-exemplar condition of Sec. 4.5 , which evaluates a trained GRACE model with an empty retrieval channel. Appendix A gives the details of the three GRACE variants. The U-Net w/o RAG and the three GRACE variants use the same corruption schedule (Sec. 3.5 ). Only the GRACE variants use the retrieval pipeline of Sec. 3.2 .

PostDAE默认使用类,通过每个解剖学一个模型. 这是最强的阶级调制形式. 形态学,TTAug和RAM基线不能使用标签. U-Net w/o RAG只接收(Y ∗,X) (Y^{*},X). blocks.zh: 4.2 GRACE作为通用精炼器

blocks.en: Table 1 reports DSC and HD95 on real upstream segmentor outputs; Fig. 3 summarises the evaluation under the three synthetic corruption severities. GRACE-M yields the largest DSC lift in three of the five upstream settings, with GRACE-U ahead on U-Net@30 and U-Net@150, and the three GRACE variants provide the three strongest HD95 reductions in every setting. Appendix D gives how often refinement decreases the DSC for each band of input DSC.

blocks.en: The benefit of retrieval grows monotonically with corruption severity, and GRACE-U and GRACE-M reduce HD95 at every severity while retrieval-free refiners are less stable (PostDAE and U-Net w/o RAG both degrade under stronger corruption). The same pattern holds for real upstream segmentors in Table 1 : strong-tier mean changes remain non-negative for all three variants and are much smaller than the weak-tier gains.
blocks.zh: 检索的好处随着腐败的严重程度而单调增长,GRACE-U和GRACE-M将HD95从每个严重程度上降低,而无检索精炼器则不那么稳定(PostDAE和U-Net w/o RAG都在更严重的腐败下退化)。 表1对真正的上游部门也采用同样的模式:在所有三种变体中,强级平均变化仍然是非负数的,远远小于弱级收益。

blocks.en: PostDAE decreases the DSC on every tier. The largest loss is on TotalSegmentator ( − 0.487 -0.487 DSC, + 10.2 +10.2 mm HD95). PostDAE replaces the input with its reconstruction through a fixed latent prior. Thus, it projects each mask onto its learned manifold. On an almost correct input, this projection removes correct detail. This explains the largest loss on the strongest upstream. PostDAE was also designed for 2D chest X-ray masks. We apply it slice by slice to 3D abdominal organs, and nothing keeps the slices consistent. This effect is largest on HD95. The row thus shows the effect of a single-anatomy 2D shape prior on volumetric multi-organ data. This is the gap that our work addresses.
blocks.zh: PostDAE 减少每一层的DSC. 损失最大的是总分号(−0.487-0.487 DSC,+10.2+10.2毫米HD95). PostDAE通过固定潜在前置替换其重建输入. 因此,它把每个面具 投射到它学到的多方面。 在几乎正确的输入上,这种投影会删除正确的细节. 这解释了最强上游最大的损失。 员额 DAE也是为2D胸X射线口罩设计的. 我们用切片切成3D腹部器官, 没有什么能保持切片的一致性。 这种效果对HD95的影响最大. 因此,该行显示了单解剖学2D形状在量子多器官数据之前的效果. 这是我们的工作所弥补的差距。

blocks.en: The three variants achieve comparable aggregate performance but differ in their behaviour on severely degraded inputs. Consistent with Table 1 , GRACE-M produces the larger mean lift on the mid and most of strong tiers, while all three variants have small non-negative mean changes on the strongest segmentor, TotalSegmentator . Mechanistically, GRACE-U is a single-pass feedforward network and produces more conservative corrections when little reliable signal is available; GRACE-M refines in a frozen latent space and can synthesise anatomically plausible completions guided by the retrieved exemplar. GRACE-M-D stays within 0.01 0.01 DSC of GRACE-M and needs about seven times more compute (Table 6 ). Its value is the uncertainty estimate for each sample, and it does not increase the accuracy.
blocks.zh: 这三种变体取得了可比较的总性能,但对于严重退化的投入,其行为有所不同。 与表1一致的是,GRACE-M在中层和大多数强层上产生较大的平均升力,而所有三种变体在最强的区段器TotalSegmentator上都有小的非负平均变化. 在机械方面,GRACE-U是一个单路支线网络,在几乎没有可靠信号的情况下产生更保守的校正;GRACE-M在冻结的潜在空间中精炼,可以合成以检索实例为指南的解剖上可信的完成。 GRACE-M-D保持在GRACE-M的0.01 0.01 DSC范围内,需要计算大约7倍(表6)。 它的价值是每个样本的不确定性估计,并不提高准确性.

blocks.en: 4.3 Generalisation to held-out datasets
blocks.zh: 4.3 被搁置数据集的一般化

blocks.en:
We evaluate GRACE on previously unseen datasets using real upstream segmentors.
Three held-out datasets are used: ProstateX, CHAOS, and LUMIERE. No case from these datasets is added to 𝒦 \mathcal{K} for this evaluation: each query retrieves only from the fixed training-corpus index described in Sec. 3.2 , and no model parameter is updated. We call this protocol held-out dataset transfer. The anatomies and modalities of these datasets also occur in other training datasets. Thus, the protocol measures transfer under dataset and acquisition shift, and it is not a zero-shot evaluation. Sec. 4.4 removes a full modality. When verified target-dataset masks are inserted into 𝒦 \mathcal{K} instead, the protocol becomes a parameter-free index extension as in Sec. 4.4 .
Table 2 reports raw and refined DSC and HD95 for three upstream segmentors (one or two per dataset) . Both GRACE variants improve DSC on every (segmentor, dataset) pair, and GRACE-U matches or exceeds GRACE-M on two scenarios, with GRACE-M ahead on the CHAOS × \times TotalSeg and LUMIERE × \times ScribblePrompt. The ordering is therefore dataset- and segmentor-dependent, unlike Table 1 , where GRACE-M led in three of the five settings . A possible explanation is that the mask-tuned decoder of GRACE-M is fitted to the training-corpus mask distribution, so its advantage narrows under dataset shift, whereas the pixel-space GRACE-U is less tied to that distribution. Appendix G reports a separate longitudinal retrieval analysis on LUMIERE.

blocks.en: We evaluate whether GRACE can refine a previously unseen anatomical class without updating its parameters. For each anatomy a a in {Liver, Spleen, Pancreas, Prostate PZ}, we retrain the refiner without a a . At test time, we add verified support cases of a a to 𝒦 \mathcal{K} . Thus, the experiment is a parameter-free index extension. The refiner receives no gradient from a a , but the index gives it examples of a a . The support cases are disjoint from the evaluation queries. Both variants improve every held-out anatomy, with mean gains of + 0.202 +0.202 DSC for GRACE-U and + 0.203 +0.203 for GRACE-M (Table 3 , Block A). The inputs are weak, with a raw DSC from 0.013 0.013 to 0.421 0.421 . Each organ needs 118 118 to 302 302 verified masks, and all four are solid organs or organ zones . The experiment shows that an index extension alone improves a held-out solid organ without a parameter update. It does not show zero-shot generalisation to unseen anatomies.

blocks.en: For each modality in {US, MRI, CT}, we remove all its datasets. No case of that modality enters the index at test time. Ultrasound is the clearest case. CAMUS has the same three cardiac structures as ACDC, so the anatomy stays almost constant. The imaging physics, the speckle and the sector geometry change. The MRI holdout is more difficult. Some MRI anatomies, such as the hippocampal subregions, do not occur in the CT and ultrasound data. Thus, the modality and part of the anatomy are both unseen.
blocks.zh: 对于{US, MRI, CT} 中的每个模式, 我们删除它的所有数据集 。 测试时没有输入这种模式的情况。 超声波是最清楚的病例. CAMUS具有与ACDC相同的三个心脏结构,因此解剖学几乎保持不变. 成像物理学,谱系和扇形几何变化. 核磁共振阻断比较困难。 一些核磁共振解剖,如河马亚种,在CT和超声波数据中并不发生. 因此,解剖学的模式和部分都是看不见的.

blocks.en: Refinement transfers from CT to MRI, but it loses most of its in-distribution gain (Table 3 , Block B). An MRI-free GRACE-U refiner with an index of 713 CT livers increases the DSC of CHAOS MRI liver from 0.515 0.515 to 0.599 0.599 ( + 0.084 +0.084 ). On the same CHAOS MRI queries, the refiner trained with MRI gains + 0.349 +0.349 . Refinement does not transfer to ultrasound. At an input DSC of 0.438 0.438 , the US-free refiner decreases the DSC to 0.236 0.236 . The refiner trained with ultrasound reaches 0.772 0.772 . Retrieval still selects the correct structure for all 101 CAMUS queries. However, the shape agreement between a query and its retrieved pool drops to 29 % 29\% of the in-modality value for ultrasound. It stays at 83 % 83\% for CT and 73 % 73\% for MRI. We did not evaluate refinement for the CT holdout, so Table 3 reports only the MRI and US holdouts. Appendix C explains the low ultrasound value.

blocks.en: Neither experiment shows zero-shot generalisation. We present transfer to unseen anatomies and modalities as an open research direction. An important question is the minimum number of support cases.

blocks.zh: 4.5 检索分析

blocks.en: We first quantify the contribution of the retrieval strategy to refinement performance and then evaluate the retrieved neighbours independently of the refiner.
blocks.zh: 我们首先量化回收战略对改进业绩的贡献,然后独立于精炼器对回收的邻居进行评价。

Table 4 evaluates the retrieval strategy with the trained GRACE-M refiner held fixed. The corrupted input without refinement is the baseline; a random same-class peer already recovers roughly 40 % 40\% of the oracle gap, indicating that the anatomically conditioned prior is useful even before any similarity ranking. Selecting the shape-aware K-NN adds a further lift, and the oracle row upper-bounds the retrieval contribution.
The gap between the random and K-NN rows measures the combined benefit of similarity-based ranking and the projected retrieval space over random same-class selection; it does not isolate the projector. The projector-versus-raw comparison in Table 5 isolates that contribution by holding the candidate set and ranking protocol fixed.

blocks.en: We set the retrieval channel of the trained model to zero and keep all other settings. This isolates the part of the gain that the exemplar gives. At the evaluation-only extreme severity, averaged over all structures, the exemplar gives 40 % 40\% of the improvement, and the refiner alone gives the rest. On the four organs of Table 11 , the share is from 39 % 39\% (pancreas) to 62 % 62\% (kidneys, spleen). In Appendix E , a mask-only encoder is close to MedGemma. Thus, the contribution comes mainly from the exemplar and less from the multimodal retrieval space. We therefore describe GRACE as exemplar-conditioned refinement. The refiner uses the retrieved exemplar as a shape prior, and retrieval selects it from the 15 indexed datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们把训练好的模型的检索通道设置为零,并保持所有其他设置. 这隔离了实例给出的收益部分. 在只评价的极端严重性,平均在所有结构上,示例给出40%的改进,仅精炼者给出其余的. 在表11的四个器官中,比例从39%的39\%(pancreas)到62%的62\%(孩子,脾脏). 在附录E中,只戴面具的编码器接近MedGemma. 因此,贡献主要来自实例,较少来自多式联运检索空间。 因此,我们认为GRACE是有条件的改进。 精炼器使用检索的示例作为形状前,从15个索引数据集中选择.

blocks.en: In a fully automatic pipeline, the class label can be wrong. We keep the trained refiner and compare three query conditions on four organs at four severities. The conditions are the correct class, a random wrong class and no exemplar (Table 11 ) . At the extreme preset, the input DSC is from 0.11 0.11 to 0.31 0.31 . The correct class gives the largest gain on every organ. A wrong class gives 0.077 0.077 to 0.151 0.151 DSC less. On the compact organs (liver, kidneys, spleen), a wrong-class exemplar still recovers 50 50 to 72 % 72\% of the correct-class gain over no exemplar. On the pancreas, which is small and variable, a wrong-class exemplar is slightly worse than no exemplar. Thus, the robustness to a wrong class depends on the shape of the target. The stabilisation of refinement under extreme class noise is an open question.

blocks.zh: 4.6 读取研究

blocks.en: We quantify the contribution of the main design choices underlying GRACE through a series of controlled ablation studies. Specifically, we evaluate the shape-aware retrieval projector while keeping the remainder of the framework unchanged; the choice of retrieval encoder is reported in Appendix E and the comparison of refinement paradigms in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 4.7 Qualitative overview
blocks.zh: 4.7 定性概述

blocks.en: Figure 5 illustrates representative refinements produced by GRACE across CT (Liver, Pancreas, Spleen) and MRI (Heart LA, Prostate PZ). For each case, one synthetic corruption and three real upstream segmentors (U-Net@150, MedSAM2, and TotalSegmentator or SegResNet) are shown together with the corresponding GRACE-U refinement, with DSC and HD95 overlaid. Three visual patterns recur across the five rows: on the weakest inputs, retrieval provides a strong anatomical prior and recovers organ topology even when the raw prediction contains no usable structure; on intermediate inputs, refinement sharpens boundaries and closes local defects; on strong inputs, refinement makes only minimal changes, consistent with the small deltas of Sec. 4.2 .
blocks.zh: 图5显示了GRACE在CT(利弗、潘克里阿斯、脾脏)和核磁共振(Heart LA、前列腺PZ)范围内产生的有代表性的改进。 对于每个案件,都显示一个合成腐败和三个真正的上游分部(U-Net@150、MedSAM2和TotalSegmentator或SegResNet),同时显示相应的GRACE-U的改进,上面有DSC和HD95。 三个视觉模式在五行之间反复出现:在最弱的输入上,检索提供强解剖功能,即使原始预测中没有可用的结构,也会恢复器官的地形;在中间输入上,精细化的边界,并关闭局部缺陷;在强精细输入上,精细化只能做最小的改变,符合Sec.4.2的小三角形.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: A central question motivating this work is whether retrieval-conditioned refinement can generalise beyond anatomy-specific correction models. Our experiments indicate that the greatest benefit of retrieval arises when the upstream segmentation is unreliable, precisely the regime in which manual correction is most costly in clinical practice ( Galati et al., 2022 ) , while already accurate predictions receive only minimal changes. The retrieved exemplar gives 40 % 40\% of the gain at the most severe preset. The correct class already gives a strong shape prior, and the shape-aware projector adds a smaller gain in that class.
blocks.zh: 推动这项工作的一个核心问题是,有检索条件的改进能否超越具体解剖学的校正模型。 我们的实验表明,当上游分解不可靠时,回收的最大好处就产生,正是人工校正在临床实践中成本最高的制度(Galati等人,2022年),而已经准确的预测只得到最小的变化。 检索到的示例在最严重预设时给出40%的40QQ收益. 正确的类在前面已经给出了一个强的形状,而形状感知投影仪在该类中增加了一个较小的增益.

blocks.en: We see four settings. (i) No strong segmentor exists for the target. TotalSegmentator covers CT anatomy, but not cardiac chambers in ultrasound or most lesion classes. (ii) The upstream is a black box, for example a vendor model without access to weights or training data. GRACE needs only the output mask. (iii) A new anatomy must be supported without retraining (Sec. 4.4 ). (iv) Promptable models receive imperfect prompts. Our MedSAM2 and ScribblePrompt results use an oracle bounding box. With real prompts, their masks are probably worse and closer to the range where refinement helps. For this reason, we put them in the mid tier. For strong CT segmentors, we do not claim an improvement. GRACE keeps good masks almost unchanged on average, but it degrades some of them (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 我们看到四个设置。 (一) 目标没有强分仪。 总分类法涵盖CT解剖学,但不包括超声波或大多数损伤类的心脏室. (二)上游是黑匣子,例如没有权重或培训数据的供应商模型. GRACE只需要输出罩. (三) 必须在不进行再培训的情况下支持新的解剖学(第4.4节)。 (四) 快速模型得到不完善的提示。 我们的MedSAM2和ScriblePrompt结果使用一个甲骨文约束框. 有了真实的提示,他们的面具可能更糟糕,也更接近改进有帮助的范围. 因此,我们把它们放在中层。 对于强大的CT分机,我们并不声称有改进. GRACE平均保持好口罩几乎不变,但可降解部分(附录D).

blocks.en: The effectiveness of retrieval depends on the diversity of the knowledge base: anatomies or pathological presentations that are not represented in 𝒦 \mathcal{K} provide weaker retrieval context, and the refiner then remains closer to the raw upstream prediction. Verified support cases can be added to 𝒦 \mathcal{K} without updating the refiner, but genuinely novel morphologies may still require retraining. At the high end of input quality, 3.8 % 3.8\% of the cases with an input DSC above 0.8 lose more than 0.05 DSC (Appendix D ). A mechanism that skips refinement for a probably correct input is a logical next step. GRACE-M-D needs about seven times more compute than GRACE-M, and its results change with the ODE seed. Transfer to a held-out modality is partial on MRI and fails on ultrasound. The leave-one-anatomy-out setting needs 118 118 to 302 302 verified masks of the held-out organ. We present both as open research directions.
blocks.zh: 检索的有效性取决于知识库的多样性: K\ mathcal{K} 中没有代表的解剖学或病理学演示文稿提供了较弱的检索上下文,然后精炼器仍然更接近原始的上游预测. 验证后的支持案例可以添加到 K\ mathcal{K} 而不更新精度, 但真正的新颖形态可能仍然需要再培训 。 在输入质量较高的端,3.8%的输入DSC高于0.8的病例损失超过0.05的DSC(附录D). 一个跳过精细化来进行可能正确的输入的机制是合乎逻辑的下一步. GRACE-M-D需要比GRACE-M多约7倍的计算,其结果随ODE种子而变化. 向被搁置模式的转移部分针对核磁共振,在超声波上失败。 一个手术室需要118 -118 -302 302 被证实的口罩 我们同时提出开放的研究方向。

blocks.en: We introduced GRACE, a retrieval-conditioned framework that replaces anatomy-specific correctors with a single refiner guided by an anatomy-aware knowledge base. Across upstream segmentors and held-out datasets, it improved unreliable predictions while leaving accurate ones largely unchanged, and verified support cases extend the knowledge base without a parameter update.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了GRACE,一个有检索条件的框架,用一个解剖意识知识库指导的单一精炼器取代解剖学特有的校正器. 在整个上游分区和搁置数据集中,它改进了不可靠的预测,同时使准确的预测基本保持不变,经核实的支助案例扩大了知识库,但没有更新参数。

blocks.en: The refiner interface (Sec. 3.4 ) admits three concrete instantiations. They are evaluated with the same data, corruption schedule, and retrieval pipeline, but differ in network architecture, refinement representation (pixel or latent), training objective, and inference procedure (deterministic forward pass or generative sampling).
blocks.zh: 精炼器接口(Sec. 3.4 )承认三种混凝土即时反应. 评估数据、腐败时间表和检索程序相同,但在网络结构、精细表述(像素或潜在)、培训目标和推论程序(决定前传或基因取样)方面各不相同。

blocks.en: The first instantiation, GRACE-U, is a supervised 3D U-Net trained on pixel-wise labels that consumes the corrupted mask, the image, and the retrieved exemplar as channel-concatenated inputs and returns a per-voxel foreground logit. It uses one forward pass with no latent codec or sampler. Its single-pass design makes it the fastest variant and empirically produces the more conservative behaviour described in Sec. 4.2 . Consistent with Table 1 , GRACE-M produces the larger mean DSC gains on the mid tier and on two of the three strong segmentors, whereas GRACE-U leads on the weak tier and on U-Net@150; all three variants have small non-negative mean changes on the strong tier.
blocks.zh: 首个即时游戏GRACE-U是受监督的3D U-Net,训练有素,能消耗腐烂的面具,图像,被检索的示例作为通道连接输入,并返回每伏xel前方日志. 它使用一个没有潜在编码器或采样器的前传. 它的单行道设计使它成为最快的变体,在经验上产生塞克描述的更为保守的行为. 4.2 (英语). 与表1一致,GRACE-M在中层和三个强分区中的两个产生较大的平均DSC增益,而GRACE-U在弱层级和U-Net@150上领先;所有三个变体在强层级上都有小的非负平均变化。

blocks.en: The second instantiation, GRACE-M, moves the refinement into the mask latent space. A frozen encoder maps the corrupted mask and the retrieved exemplar into a compact 4 × 24 3 4{\times}\!24^{3} latent. A small fusion module (concat, FiLM, or cross-attention) combines the two latents, while a mask-tuned decoder returns the refined mask. Since the decoded output is drawn from the learned mask manifold, this paradigm can produce a plausible completion even when the input carries almost no signal. The reported latent variants use a frozen MAISI encoder together with a decoder fine-tuned on the binary-mask distribution (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 第二次即时反应,GRACE-M,将精度移入面具潜伏空间. 一个被冻结的编码器将腐烂的面具和收回的示例映射成一个紧凑的 4× 24 3 4}%%%%!24×3}潜伏。 一个小型的聚变模块(concat,FiLM,或交叉意念)结合了两个潜质,而一个面具调制解码器则返回精制的面具. 由于解码输出来自学习过的面具多面体,即使输入几乎没有信号,这种范式也能产生一个可信的完成. 报告的潜在变体使用冷冻的MAISI编码器以及二进制-掩模分布(附录B)上的解码器微调。

blocks.en: The third instantiation, GRACE-M-D, replaces the deterministic latent decode with an ODE integration of a learned velocity field conditioned on the retrieved exemplar, following flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) for latent generative models. Inference becomes stochastic in the choice of initial noise, so a batch of runs on the same input yields a family of plausible refinements; averaging or selecting among them supports the sample-level uncertainty estimates that neither deterministic paradigm provides. On the aggregate benchmark in Table 6 , its 30-step aggregate DSC closely matches the deterministic GRACE-M decode while inference is roughly seven times slower; its practical value therefore lies in downstream workflows that consume uncertainty rather than in additional aggregate DSC.
blocks.zh: 第三次即时反应,即GRACE-M-D,在对潜在基因模型进行流配后(Lipman等人,2023年),用ODE集成一个在检索实例上具备条件的学习速度场,取代了决定性潜在解码。 推论在选择初始噪声时变得有条理,因此,在同一输入量上进行的批次运行会产生一种合理的改进;平均或从中选择支持样本层次的不确定性估计,这两个确定性模式都没有提供。 在表6的合计基准上,其30步总计的DSC与决定性的GRACE-M解码非常吻合,而推论则大约慢7倍;因此其实用价值在于消耗不确定性的下游工作流程,而不是额外的总计DSC.

blocks.en:
These architectural differences are reflected in the empirical behaviour observed across experiments.
Table 1 supports regime-wise comparisons for the three variants : GRACE-M has the larger mean lift on the mid and most of the strong tiers, while all three variants have small non-negative mean changes on the top performing model (TotalSegmentator). On the aggregate benchmark of Table 6 , averaged over three ODE seeds, the 30-step GRACE-M-D stays within 0.01 0.01 DSC of GRACE-M.

Table 6 reports wall-clock inference time per case and mean DSC for the three refiner paradigms. Measurements were obtained on a single NVIDIA A100 with batch size one using ten representative cases (one per MSD organ) from a stratified 10% hold-out. Each benchmark run covers those ten cases; runtime means and sample standard deviations are computed across five repeated runs, with GPU synchronisation before each measurement.
GRACE-U runs sub-second per case using one forward pass, and GRACE-M adds a single deterministic latent decode. GRACE-M-D requires several seconds at the 30-step operating point because of iterative ODE integration (see Table 6 ). All three variants share the same retrieval pipeline, allowing deployments to switch between refiners without modifying the surrounding retrieval infrastructure.

blocks.en: The refiner interface of Sec. 3.4 admits several concrete instantiations. This appendix reports the empirical characterisation that motivates the choices adopted in the main paper. Three design axes are examined in controlled comparisons: (i) how the retrieved exemplar Y r Y_{r} enters the refiner ( fusion module ); (ii) whether inference uses the deterministic GRACE-M decode or the GRACE-M-D flow-matching trajectory; and (iii) the training loss, exemplar selection, and velocity-network width for GRACE-M-D. Settings outside the axis under study are held fixed within each comparison. The same fusion-module ablation is repeated on the pixel-space variant GRACE-U for completeness.

blocks.en: Three interfaces for injecting the retrieved exemplar into the refiner are compared. The concat module stacks the encoded corrupted latent and the encoded exemplar latent along the channel axis and applies a 1 × 1 × 1 1{\times}1{\times}1 convolution with identity initialisation so the refiner recovers the corrupted-only forward pass at step zero. The FiLM module pools the encoded exemplar over the spatial dimensions, passes it through a small MLP that emits per-channel scale and shift, and applies them to the corrupted latent. The cross-attention module is a single-head projected attention layer with the corrupted latent tokens as queries and the encoded exemplar tokens as keys and values. The pixel-space ablation applies the corresponding conditioning operations to U-Net feature maps. Table 7 reports refined DSC for both refiner variants. Concat gives the highest score for each variant and is retained as the default for its accuracy, parameter economy, and interpretability. Additionally, Table 8 reports controlled combinations of training changes for GRACE-M-D: the auxiliary Dice loss and the K-NN exemplar each improve the common baseline, their combination improves it further, and widening the velocity network produces the highest score at roughly twice the parameter count.

blocks.en: This appendix explains the ultrasound result of Table 3 (Block B). Class routing does not cause the ultrasound failure: all 101 CAMUS queries retrieve the correct cardiac structure. The shape agreement between a query and its retrieved pool decreases. The low ultrasound ratio has a specific cause. CAMUS is 2D+time, so its third axis is the cardiac cycle. ACDC and MSD Heart are spatial volumes. The CAMUS long-axis views (2CH, 4CH) also retrieve short-axis support cases. The shape agreement per structure follows the view dependence of the structure: myocardium 0.125 0.125 , left atrium 0.239 0.239 , LV cavity 0.433 0.433 . We think that shape complexity is an important factor in retrieval. Thus, the ultrasound row does not measure the modality alone.

blocks.en: Appendix E Retrieval encoder choice
blocks.zh: 附录 E 检索编码器选择

blocks.en: Table 10 evaluates the impact of the retrieval encoder while keeping the refiner and the knowledge-base size fixed. We compare two families of retrieval embeddings: four pretrained foundation encoders (DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , BiomedCLIP ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , MedSigLIP ( Sellergren et al., 2025 ) , and MedGemma) and three mask-domain variants derived from a frozen MAISI ( Guo et al., 2025 ) VAE encoder. The three mask-domain variants use (i) pooled latent features directly, (ii) pooled features followed by PCA reduction, and (iii) a learned two-layer self-projector trained on the same latent representation. Among foundation encoders, MedGemma achieves the best performance, followed closely by the remaining medical encoders, whereas DINOv2 consistently trails them. The strongest mask-domain variant closely approaches MedGemma despite relying solely on anatomical shape information, suggesting that shape alone carries a strong retrieval signal.
blocks.zh: 表10评价了检索编码器的影响,同时保持了精炼器和知识基大小的固定. 我们比较了两个家族的检索嵌入:四个经过预先培训的基础编码器(DINOv2(Oquab等人,2024年),BiomedCLIP(张等人,2025年),MedSigLIP) (Sellergren等人,2025年),和MedGemma)和三种口罩域变种,来源于一个冷冻的MAISI(Guo等人,2025年) VAE编码器. 三种掩码域变体直接使用(一)集合潜在特征,(二)集合特征,然后减少五氯苯甲醚,以及(三)一个受过同样潜在代表性培训的双层自投项目员。 在基金会编码器中,MedGemma取得了最佳的性能,紧随其后的是其余的医学编码器,而DINOv2则始终跟踪它们. 最强的面具-域变体虽然只依靠解剖形状信息,却紧紧靠近MedGemma,暗示单是形状就带有强大的检索信号.

blocks.en: Table 10 : Retrieval encoder ablation. Performance on the strong synthetic-corruption preset with different retrieval encoders while keeping the GRACE-M refiner, knowledge-base size, and corruption schedule fixed. The mask-domain variants construct retrieval embeddings from the frozen MAISI VAE encoder: the first uses adaptive pooling alone, the second adds PCA reduction, and the third replaces PCA with a learned two-layer MLP. This comparison assesses how far anatomical shape alone can approach multimodal retrieval. “Encoder dim.” reports the dimensionality emitted by the listed encoder or reduction, rather than the 256-dimensional shape-aware index used by the main pipeline. Unlike the main experiments ( k = 5 k=5 ), all rows in this ablation use top- k k retrieval with k = 3 k=3 and spatial-exemplar conditioning.

blocks.en: An emergent behaviour of the retrieval pipeline appears on the longitudinal LUMIERE dataset when the temporal-memory workflow is enabled: as a patient’s visits are embedded into 𝒦 \mathcal{K} , later refinements retrieve the patient’s own prior scans instead of cross-patient atlases (Fig. 6 ). At the first visit, retrieved neighbours are tumour examples from other patients in the training pool; once the patient’s first scan is indexed, it becomes the highest-ranked retrieval at the next visit; by the third visit, prior visits dominate the top- k k list. No temporal supervision is used: retrieval is driven by similarity in the embedding space. This optional workflow is separate from Table 2 , whose held-out-dataset protocol uses the fixed training-only index and therefore excludes every LUMIERE case from the candidate pool. On the subset of LUMIERE with at least one prior visit ( n = 508 n{=}508 timepoints), enabling same-patient retrieval yields an additional DSC lift of + 0.021 +0.021 on the ScribblePrompt upstream , on top of the fixed-index score of the corresponding row of Table 2 ; whether this lift is admissible depends on the clinical workflow (a longitudinal QC pass at visit t t that already trusts the visit- ( t − 1 ) (t{-}1) mask, versus a per-visit review pipeline that does not) and is reported separately rather than folded into the headline number. The mechanism acts as an implicit temporal memory and supports longitudinal workflows without dedicated temporal architectures.
blocks.zh: 当时间-记忆工作流程启用时,在纵向LUMIERE数据集上出现了检索管道的突发行为:由于病人的访问被嵌入到K\mathcal{K}中,后来的改进可以检索病人自己以前的扫描,而不是跨病人地图集(图6)。 在第一次访问时,取回的邻居是训练池中其他病人的肿瘤例子;一旦病人的第一次扫描被索引,在下一次访问时就成为排名最高的检索者;到第三次访问时,前几次访问占据了最高的-k k名单. 不使用时间监督:检索是由嵌入空间中的相似性驱动的. 这种可选的工作流程与表2分开,表2的持有数据集协议使用固定的只训练索引,因此将每个LUMIERE案例排除在候选集合之外. 在至少有一次前访的LUMIERE子集(n = 508 n{=}508时间点)上,允许同位病人检索在ScriblePrompt上游增加一个+ 0.021+0.021的DSC升力,在表2相应行的固定指数分数之上;这种升力是否可以被接受取决于临床工作流程(访问时的纵向QC通过,已经相信访问-(t − 1) (t{}1) 遮罩,而不是不进行逐次访问审查的管道),并且单独报告而不是折叠到头条号. 该机制起到隐含的时间记忆的作用,支持没有专用的时间架构的纵向工作流程.
